nodes.name: useApi.ts
nodes.summary: Composable that creates an Axios HTTP client instance with JWT auth interceptor (attaches Bearer token), 401 auto-logout, and 403 RBAC-denied event dispatching.

nodes.name: useApi
nodes.summary: Returns a configured Axios instance with request/response interceptors for JWT auth, 401 redirect, and 403 custom event dispatch.

nodes.name: useAuthorization.ts
nodes.summary: Composable providing RBAC role, permission, and guard URL access checking functions (hasRole, hasPermission, canAccessUrl) derived from auth store user data.

nodes.name: useAuthorization
nodes.summary: Computes user roles, permissions, and guard URLs from auth store; provides hasRole, hasPermission, and canAccessUrl checking functions.

nodes.name: useDataTable.ts
nodes.summary: Composable managing DataTable state: search text/field, sort, column visibility, debounce, and filter reset with reactive watchers triggering fetch.

nodes.name: useDataTable
nodes.summary: Creates reactive DataTable state (search, sort, column visibility) with debounced search and auto-fetch watchers.

nodes.name: useGuardsData.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for Guard entities: display name formatting, find-by-name/id, filter-by-type (allow/deny), and sort-by-name.

nodes.name: formatGuardDisplayName
nodes.summary: Returns the guardName as display string for a Guard entity.

nodes.name: findGuardByName
nodes.summary: Finds a Guard by its guardName in an array of guards.

nodes.name: filterGuardsByType
nodes.summary: Filters guards that have at least one URL with the specified type (allow or deny).

nodes.name: usePageTransition.ts
nodes.summary: Composable wrapping Anime.js for page transitions: fadeInUp, fadeIn, staggerFadeIn, slideInLeft animations with SSR safety checks.

nodes.name: usePageTransition
nodes.summary: Returns animation helpers (fadeInUp, fadeIn, staggerFadeIn, slideInLeft) using Anime.js from Nuxt plugin.

nodes.name: usePermissionsData.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for Permission entities: display name formatting, find-by-name, filter-by-method/url, and sort-by-name.

nodes.name: filterPermissionsByMethod
nodes.summary: Filters permissions that have at least one method matching the specified HTTP method.

nodes.name: useRolesData.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for Role entities: display name formatting, find-by-name/id, filter-with-permissions, and sort-by-name.

nodes.name: filterRolesWithPermissions
nodes.summary: Filters roles that have at least one permission assigned.

nodes.name: useUsersData.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for User entities: display name formatting, initials extraction, filter-by-role, find-by-email/username, and sort-by-name.

nodes.name: formatUserDisplayName
nodes.summary: Returns full name (firstName + lastName) as display string for a User.

nodes.name: getUserInitials
nodes.summary: Returns first character of firstName + first character of lastName as initials.

nodes.name: filterUsersByRole
nodes.summary: Filters users that have a role with the specified roleName.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Nuxt route middleware handling auth guard: server-side cookie check, client-side token restoration from localStorage, route meta requiresAuth/guest/requiredRoles enforcement, and RBAC-denied event dispatch.

nodes.name: animejs.client.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side Nuxt plugin that imports and provides the Anime.js animation library as $anime via Nuxt's provide/inject.

nodes.name: naiveui-components.ts
nodes.summary: Nuxt plugin that globally registers the NMessageProvider component from Naive UI for use in templates without explicit imports.

nodes.name: naiveui.client.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side Nuxt plugin that provides the Naive UI theme overrides (from naiveui-theme.ts) as $naiveui.theme.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Utility to extract user-friendly error messages from Axios/API error responses, falling back to a provided default message.

nodes.name: getErrorMessage
nodes.summary: Extracts error message from Axios error response data or error object, joining arrays and falling back to default.

nodes.name: icons.ts
nodes.summary: Utility that wraps any Vue component into a renderable Naive UI NIcon wrapper for use in menu items and buttons.

nodes.name: renderIcon
nodes.summary: Wraps a Vue component into a function returning NIcon for use in Naive UI menu/button icon slots.

nodes.name: naiveui-theme.ts
nodes.summary: Naive UI GlobalThemeOverrides defining the app's design system: primary blue (#3B82F6), Inter font, 6px border radius, light color palette, and component-specific overrides for Button, Input, Card.

nodes.name: url-matcher.ts
nodes.summary: URL pattern matcher supporting exact match, wildcard prefix (/*), and trailing slash normalization for RBAC guard URL matching.

nodes.name: matchUrlPattern
nodes.summary: Matches a URL against a pattern supporting /* wildcards and trailing slash normalization.

nodes.name: app.vue
nodes.summary: Root Vue component wrapping NuxtLayout and NuxtPage inside NMessageProvider for global message notifications.

nodes.name: auth.vue
nodes.summary: Auth layout with split-screen design: image panel (settings-driven gradient/image with app branding) and form panel (slot for login/register content). Supports configurable image position via route meta.

nodes.name: default.vue
nodes.summary: Default authenticated layout with collapsible sidebar navigation (role-based menu items), header with user dropdown (profile/logout), and content area. Uses settings store for app name and auth store for user data.

nodes.name: index.vue
nodes.summary: Root index page that immediately redirects to /login using navigateTo.

nodes.name: login.vue
nodes.summary: Login page with email/password form using Naive UI components, form validation, auth store login integration, error handling via getErrorMessage, and animated transitions.

nodes.name: register.vue
nodes.summary: Registration page with multi-field form (firstName, lastName, username, email, password, confirmPassword), validation rules, auth store register integration, and animated transitions.

nodes.name: index.vue
nodes.summary: Dashboard home page displaying user profile info card and quick-action buttons (Manage Users, Roles, Permissions, Guards) with navigation to respective CRUD pages.

nodes.name: activity-logs.vue
nodes.summary: Activity logs page with DataTable for paginated log entries, action/entity/level filter selects, detail drawer with full log info (user, action, entity, description, IP, user agent, metadata).

nodes.name: guards.vue
nodes.summary: Guards management page composing GuardTable, GuardFormModal (create/edit), and GuardDetailDrawer with event-driven state management.

nodes.name: permissions.vue
nodes.summary: Permissions management page composing PermissionTable, PermissionFormModal (create/edit), and PermissionDetailDrawer with event-driven state management.

nodes.name: profile.vue
nodes.summary: Profile page with two cards: profile info form (firstName, lastName, username, email) and change password form (currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword), both with validation and auth store integration.

nodes.name: roles.vue
nodes.summary: Roles management page composing RoleTable, RoleFormModal (create/edit), and RoleDetailDrawer with event-driven state management.

nodes.name: settings.vue
nodes.summary: Application settings page with cards for app name, description, favicon upload, and login background (image upload with gradient fallback color pickers). Uses settings store for persistence.

nodes.name: system-logs.vue
nodes.summary: System logs viewer with file selector, level filter, statistics bar (counts per level), DataTable for log entries, and LogDetailDrawer. Fetches log files list and content from API.

nodes.name: users.vue
nodes.summary: Users management page composing UserTable, UserFormModal (create/edit), and UserDetailDrawer with event-driven state management.
